hints.title: Bidirectional Cumulative Weight Balancing
hints.text: The median in a weighted frequency distribution is any number whose cumulative frequency from both the left and right exceeds half the total frequency.

hints.title: Dual Running Sum Window Comparison
hints.text: Compute ascending cumulative frequency and descending cumulative frequency over numbers ordered by value. Check that both running sums are greater than or equal to sum(frequency) / 2.0.

hints.title: Median Frequency Blueprint
hints.text: With CTE as (select num, sum(frequency) over(order by num asc) as cum_asc, sum(frequency) over(order by num desc) as cum_desc, sum(frequency) over() as total from Numbers) select round(avg(num), 1) as median from CTE where cum_asc >= total / 2.0 and cum_desc >= total / 2.0.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
WITH Cumulative AS (
    SELECT 
        num,
        SUM(frequency) OVER(ORDER BY num ASC) AS cum_asc,
        SUM(frequency) OVER(ORDER BY num DESC) AS cum_desc,
        SUM(frequency) OVER() AS total_freq
    FROM Numbers
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(num), 1) AS median
FROM Cumulative
WHERE cum_asc >= total_freq / 2.0 
  AND cum_desc >= total_freq / 2.0;
```

variables: N: number of distinct number rows
complexity.notes: Window prefix and suffix sums evaluate in sorted linear-logarithmic time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Expanding frequency counts into individual uncompressed rows wastes massive memory.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual cumulative window sums avoid table unnesting.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Using ascending and descending cumulative weights to identify median boundaries.

        SUM(frequency) OVER(ORDER BY num ASC) AS cum_asc,

        SUM(frequency) OVER() AS total_freq

SELECT ROUND(AVG(num), 1) AS median
FROM Cumulative

  AND cum_desc >= total_freq / 2.0;

WITH Cumulative AS (
    SELECT 
        num,
        SUM(frequency) OVER(ORDER BY num ASC) AS cum_asc,
        SUM(frequency) OVER(ORDER BY num DESC) AS cum_desc,
        SUM(frequency) OVER() AS total_freq
    FROM Numbers
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(num)::numeric, 1)::double precision AS median
FROM Cumulative
WHERE cum_asc >= total_freq / 2.0 
  AND cum_desc >= total_freq / 2.0;

import pandas as pd

def median_frequency(numbers: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = numbers.sort_values(by='num')
    total = df['frequency'].sum()
    df['cum_asc'] = df['frequency'].cumsum()
    df['cum_desc'] = df['frequency'].iloc[::-1].cumsum().iloc[::-1]
    medians = df[(df['cum_asc'] >= total / 2.0) & (df['cum_desc'] >= total / 2.0)]
    med_val = round(medians['num'].mean(), 1)
    return pd.DataFrame({'median': [med_val]})
